visualCharacteristics.purpose: Email newsletter signup form (email input + submit button)
notes: Dark #1d1f22 band; heading + paragraph on the left, email input with Sign up button on the right.

contentPattern.structure: optional key/value rows: action (submit URL), label, placeholder, button, success, error; a single-cell row with a link also sets the submit URL. With no rows it renders an email field and a Sign up button
patterns: no variant: forms keep the name form
blockContent: Email signup form: email field + Sign up button

usage.description: Newsletter signup band; place heading and text as default content beside it in a split section.

reuseGuidance: Use for single-field email signups. Multi-field forms need a different form model.
